texts.yuchuaner向王夫人报告，贾母院现在无人。: Yuchuan'er reported to Lady Wang that Grandmother Jia's courtyard is currently empty.
texts.yuchuaner在王夫人处告诉周瑞家，贾母的院子现在无人居住。: Yuchuan'er told Zhou Ruijia at Lady Wang's that Grandmother Jia's courtyard is currently unoccupied.
texts.yuchuaner在王夫人处恭候王夫人发落。: Yuchuan'er waited on Lady Wang to receive her instructions.
texts.yuchuaner在王夫人处，向王夫人报到并禀告。: Yuchuan'er reported to and formally notified Lady Wang at her place.
texts.yuchuaner带薛姨妈去查看薛蟠与薛宝钗的住处布置。: Yuchuan'er took Aunt Xue to inspect the arrangements of Xue Pan's and Xue Baochai's quarters.
texts.yuchuaner当面询问薛姨妈是否需要添置被褥、衣物或日用之物。: Yuchuan'er asked Aunt Xue in person whether she needed additional bedding, clothing, or daily necessities.
texts.临睡时，花袭人或指定首席丫鬟须督促贾宝玉服下丸药并陪同贾宝玉直至就寝。: At bedtime, Hua Xiren or a designated head maid must ensure Jia Baoyu takes his pills and accompany him until he goes to bed.
texts.刘姥姥在大观楼向贾珍承诺遵命退下，并称若有差遣随时听命。: At the Grand View Pavilion, Granny Liu promised Jia Zhen she would withdraw as ordered and said she would obey any summons.
texts.刘姥姥在大观楼对贾母表示：愿去后厨取些乡下自制糖饼献上，若合老太太口味便知足。: At the Grand View Pavilion, Granny Liu told Grandmother Jia she would fetch some homemade country sugar cakes from the kitchen to offer and would be satisfied if they pleased the old lady's taste.
texts.刘姥姥在大观楼得知王熙凤已经安排好了座位。: At the Grand View Pavilion, Granny Liu learned that Wang Xifeng had already arranged the seating.
texts.刘姥姥在大观楼得知贾宝玉在一旁陪同。: At the Grand View Pavilion, Granny Liu learned that Jia Baoyu was there accompanying them.
texts.刘姥姥在大观楼得知贾蓉和贾珍在收拾正厅并备上茶点。: At the Grand View Pavilion, Granny Liu learned that Jia Rong and Jia Zhen were tidying the main hall and preparing tea and snacks.
texts.刘姥姥在大观楼恳请王熙凤代为求情，恳请王熙凤准许刘姥姥去大观楼后厨取两盘家乡自制: At the Grand View Pavilion, Granny Liu begged Wang Xifeng to intercede and asked permission to fetch two plates of her homemade country sweets from the pavilion kitchen.
texts.刘姥姥在荣庆堂感谢贾母与王熙凤的周到招待，表示愿常来逗笑并带乡下点心讨贾母欢心。: In Rongqing Hall, Granny Liu thanked Grandmother Jia and Wang Xifeng for their thoughtful hospitality and said she would often come to amuse them and bring country snacks to please Grandmother Jia.
texts.刘姥姥表示若那两盘家乡自制的糖饼合贾母口味，刘姥姥愿日后常来献小点心以讨贾母与众: Granny Liu said that if the two plates of her homemade country sugar cakes suited Grandmother Jia's taste, she would henceforth often bring small snacks to win Grandmother Jia's and everyone's favor.
texts.参加海棠诗社的诸人围绕海棠题材互相吟咏并酬和诗句。: Members of the Haitang Poetry Society recited and exchanged poems among themselves on the subject of the crabapple (haitang).
texts.史湘云以诗回应贾芸关于小红下落的询问。: Shi Xiangyun answered Jia Yun's question about Xiaohong's whereabouts with a poem.
texts.史湘云在蘅芜苑的海棠诗社聚会中回应贾惜春。: At the Haitang Poetry Society gathering in Hengwu Garden, Shi Xiangyun responded to Jia Xichun.
texts.史湘云在蘅芜苑的海棠诗社聚会中就座并吟咏两句: 海棠半吐晓光红，疏雨敛香湿粉妆。: At the Haitang Poetry Society meeting in Hengwu Garden, Shi Xiangyun took her seat and recited two lines: 'The crabapple half-opens, dawn's light red; sparse rain gathers fragrance, wetting powdered makeup.'
texts.史湘云在蘅芜苑的海棠诗社聚会中续吟诗句：“一枝残影映春丛。”: Shi Xiangyun continued with the line: 'A single remnant branch's shadow mirrors the spring cluster.'
texts.史湘云在蘅芜苑的海棠诗社聚会中续吟诗句：“倚栏凝望怜芳容。”: Shi Xiangyun continued with the line: 'Leaning on the railing, I gaze, pitying the fair bloom.'
texts.史湘云在蘅芜苑的海棠诗社聚会中续吟诗句：“微雨轻敛花心润。”: Shi Xiangyun continued with the line: 'Light rain gently gathers, moistening the flower's heart.'
texts.史湘云在蘅芜苑的海棠诗社聚会中续吟诗句：“暗香浮动入帘风。”: Shi Xiangyun continued with the line: 'Hidden fragrance drifts in on the curtain breeze.'
texts.周瑞家下令为薛蟠和薛宝钗各在贾府内准备一间住处。: Zhou Ruijia ordered that separate rooms be prepared inside the Jia mansion for Xue Pan and Xue Baochai.
texts.周瑞家向王夫人禀报说王奶奶暂时不在贾母的院子里。: Zhou Ruijia reported to Lady Wang that Old Madam Wang is temporarily not in Grandmother Jia's courtyard.
texts.周瑞家向王夫人禀报说薛姨妈与她的子女已在贾府的内宅暂住。: Zhou Ruijia reported to Lady Wang that Aunt Xue and her children are temporarily staying in the inner quarters of the Jia household.
texts.周瑞家向王夫人禀报说贾母的院中目前无人。: Zhou Ruijia reported to Lady Wang that Grandmother Jia's courtyard is currently empty.
texts.周瑞家告知玉钏儿：薛姨妈与薛姨妈的子女已在内宅暂住。: Zhou Ruijia informed Yuchuan'er that Aunt Xue and Aunt Xue's children are temporarily staying in the inner quarters.
texts.周瑞家告知玉钏儿：贾母的院子里无人。: Zhou Ruijia informed Yuchuan'er that Grandmother Jia's courtyard is empty.
texts.周瑞家命玉钏儿入内去向王夫人回禀。: Zhou Ruijia ordered Yuchuan'er to go inside to report back to Lady Wang.
texts.周瑞家命玉钏儿回禀周奶奶。: Zhou Ruijia ordered Yuchuan'er to report back to Grandmother Zhou.
texts.周瑞家在向王夫人禀报时，请求王奶奶到时召玉钏儿前来面禀。: While reporting to Lady Wang, Zhou Ruijia asked Grandmother Wang to summon Yuchuan'er to come and report in person when the time came.
texts.周瑞家在王夫人处禀报，通报贾母院与薛家人的相关情况。: Zhou Ruijia reported to Lady Wang, informing her of the relevant situation regarding Grandmother Jia's quarters and the Xue family members.
texts.周瑞家将上述准许薛姨妈入内暂住及为薛蟠与薛宝钗备住处的决定禀告给王奶奶，请示王奶: Zhou Ruijia informed Grandmother Wang of the decision to permit Aunt Xue to stay inside temporarily and to prepare lodgings for Xue Pan and Xue Baochai, and asked Grandmother Wang how to handle it.
texts.命婢女守门留意，若贾赦到来即刻禀报；将菜盆覆上保温，调匀粥味并置于暖盘，茶盏摆正: Ordered the maid at the gate to be watchful and to report immediately if Jia She arrived; to cover the vegetable basin to keep it warm, even out the porridge's flavor and place it on a warming plate, set the teacup upright, (text truncated).
texts.因需在府中照料年迈的姥姥，板儿婉辞了薛蟠的邀请。: Because she needed to care for her elderly maternal grandmother in the household, Ban'er politely declined Xue Pan's invitation.
texts.在大观楼，接待林黛玉的席位已经准备好。: At the Grand View Pavilion, the seat for receiving Lin Daiyu had already been prepared.
texts.在大观楼，王熙凤又交代贾珍：若林黛玉在前来大观楼途中遇阻滞，贾珍应立即来禀报王熙: At the Grand View Pavilion, Wang Xifeng again instructed Jia Zhen that if Lin Daiyu encountered delays on her way to the Pavilion, Jia Zhen should immediately report to Wang Xifeng.
texts.在大观楼，王熙凤嘱咐贾珍务必连声催请林黛玉前来大观楼。: At the Grand View Pavilion, Wang Xifeng urged Jia Zhen to repeatedly press Lin Daiyu to come to the Pavilion.
texts.在大观楼，王熙凤还吩咐贾珍：若林黛玉已动身前来大观楼，贾珍应回话示明林黛玉的所在: At the Grand View Pavilion, Wang Xifeng also told Jia Zhen that if Lin Daiyu had already set out for the Pavilion, Jia Zhen should reply indicating Lin Daiyu's location and whereabouts en route.
texts.在大观楼，贾宝玉吩咐众人如果林黛玉到来，应当立即将林黛玉引到贾母跟前。: At the Grand View Pavilion, Jia Baoyu instructed everyone that if Lin Daiyu arrived, she should be immediately led to Grandmother Jia's presence.
texts.在大观楼，贾宝玉嘱咐其他闲散的人迅速退下，不得在大观楼滞留。: At the Grand View Pavilion, Jia Baoyu told the other idle people to withdraw quickly and not to linger in the Pavilion.
texts.在大观楼，贾珍吩咐贾蓉立刻收拾正厅并备上茶点。: At the Grand View Pavilion, Jia Zhen ordered Jia Rong to immediately tidy the main hall and prepare tea and refreshments.
texts.在大观楼，贾珍命令人把闲散的人等都退下离开。: At the Grand View Pavilion, Jia Zhen commanded that the idle people be sent away and leave.
texts.在大观楼，贾珍嘱咐刘姥姥先落座，不必拘礼。: At the Grand View Pavilion, Jia Zhen told Granny Liu to sit down first and not to stand on ceremony.
texts.在大观楼，贾珍派人去请林黛玉到场来见贾母。: At the Grand View Pavilion, Jia Zhen sent someone to invite Lin Daiyu to come and see Grandmother Jia.
texts.在大观楼，贾珍留在贾母身侧维持席上秩序。: At the Grand View Pavilion, Jia Zhen remained at Grandmother Jia's side to maintain order at the gathering.
texts.在大观楼，贾珍请薛宝钗与薛姨妈在旁多加伺候贾母。: At the Grand View Pavilion, Jia Zhen asked Xue Baochai and Aunt Xue to attend more closely to Grandmother Jia at her side.
texts.在怡红院的偏院、假山与花园，晴雯暂未找到贾宝玉。: In the side pavilion, rockery, and garden of the Yihong Courtyard, Qingwen had not yet found Jia Baoyu.
texts.在怡红院，丫鬟晴雯按照贾政安排的分工仔细查看了假山。: In the Yihong Courtyard, maid Qingwen, following the division of labor arranged by Jia Zheng, carefully searched the rockery.
texts.在怡红院，丫鬟晴雯按照贾政安排的分工仔细查看了偏院。: In the Yihong Courtyard, maid Qingwen, following the division of labor arranged by Jia Zheng, carefully searched the side pavilion.
texts.在怡红院，丫鬟晴雯按照贾政安排的分工仔细查看了花园。: In the Yihong Courtyard, maid Qingwen, following the division of labor arranged by Jia Zheng, carefully searched the garden.
texts.在潇湘馆床前继续细心照料林黛玉：轻抚额头与腕脉察其气息，喂她一小口温薄粥，替她整: At Xiaoxiang Pavilion beside the bed, continued to carefully tend Lin Daiyu: gently stroked her forehead and wrist pulse to check her breathing, fed her a small sip of warm thin congee, arranged her bedding and covered her (text truncated).
texts.在荣国府，薛蟠叮嘱板儿好生照看板儿的姥姥。: In Rongguo Mansion, Xue Pan instructed Ban'er to take good care of Ban'er's maternal grandmother.
texts.在荣国府，薛蟠命令人摆酒准备宴席。: In Rongguo Mansion, Xue Pan ordered people to set out wine and prepare a feast.
texts.在荣国府，薛蟠嘱咐贾琏留在府中等候薛蟠回府后回禀。: In Rongguo Mansion, Xue Pan told Jia Lian to remain in the residence and wait to report back after Xue Pan returned.
texts.在荣国府，薛蟠宣布自己即刻上街闹事。: In Rongguo Mansion, Xue Pan announced that he would immediately go out into the street to make a disturbance.
texts.在荣国府，贾琏因要接待来客，推辞不随薛蟠上街。: Jia Lian, because he had to receive guests, declined to go out into the street with Xue Pan.
texts.在蘅芜苑的海棠诗社小聚上，众位女子开始依次吟咏并互相评点诗作。: At the Haitang Poetry Club gathering in Hengwu Garden, the women began to take turns reciting and critiquing poems.
texts.在该吟社中，贾惜春与林黛玉、史湘云等人一起唱和诗句。: At the poetry society, Jia Xichun joined Lin Daiyu, Shi Xiangyun and others in composing and responding to lines of poetry.
texts.外祖母的旨意是留贾宝玉在贾母身侧恭立伺候。: The maternal grandmother's decree was to keep Jia Baoyu standing respectfully beside Grandmother Jia to attend her.
texts.外祖母的旨意还规定贾宝玉近前就座时不必屈膝下跪，行礼以抱拳拱手或微低头示意恭敬。: The maternal grandmother's decree also stipulated that when Jia Baoyu approaches to sit he need not kneel; he should salute by clasping his fists and cupping his hands or by slightly bowing his head to show respect.
texts.大观楼当前在场的人有贾母、贾宝玉、贾珍、贾蓉、王熙凤、刘姥姥、薛宝钗和小红。: Those currently present at the Grand View Tower are Grandmother Jia, Jia Baoyu, Jia Zhen, Jia Rong, Wang Xifeng, Granny Liu, Xue Baochai, and Xiao Hong.
texts.大观楼正厅目前没有任何突发状况。: There are currently no unexpected incidents in the main hall of the Grand View Tower.
texts.如贾宝玉出现异常，花袭人或花袭人指定的首席丫鬟要将贾宝玉即刻送到王夫人处诊治。: If Jia Baoyu shows any abnormality, Hua Xiren or the chief maid designated by Hua Xiren must immediately take Jia Baoyu to Lady Wang for treatment.
texts.姥姥已被安置在里屋，并已吃过热饭。: Granny Liu has been settled in the inner room and has eaten hot food.
texts.小红前往大观楼和贾政书房打听贾宝玉的下落，并承诺有音信马上禀报晴雯。: Xiao Hong went to the Grand View Tower and Jia Zheng's study to inquire about Jia Baoyu's whereabouts, and promised to report to Qingwen immediately if she got any news.
texts.小红向晴雯、袭人、莺儿问候:她来看看大家，并问有什么需要她帮忙的。: Xiao Hong greeted Qingwen, Xiren, and Ying'er: she came to see everyone and asked if there was anything she could do to help.
texts.小红在大观楼向晴雯禀报：贾宝玉目前在大观楼荣庆堂陪在贾母身旁。: Xiao Hong reported to Qingwen at the Grand View Tower that Jia Baoyu is currently in Rongqing Hall of the Grand View Tower, beside Grandmother Jia.
texts.小红在大观楼向贾宝玉禀报，说明晴雯正在怡红院等候。: At the Grand View Tower, Xiao Hong informed Jia Baoyu that Qingwen was waiting at Yihong Court.
texts.小红在大观楼请示贾宝玉，问是否现在叫在怡红院等候的晴雯来荣庆堂，还是等晴雯传话来: At the Grand View Tower, Xiao Hong asked Jia Baoyu whether she should call Qingwen, who is waiting at Yihong Court, to come to Rongqing Hall now or wait for Qingwen to send word.
texts.小红已去大观楼与贾政书房打听贾宝玉的下落。: Xiao Hong has gone to the Grand View Tower and Jia Zheng's study to inquire about Jia Baoyu's whereabouts.
texts.小红已在大观楼将贾宝玉的嘱托转告给在怡红院等候的晴雯。: Xiao Hong has conveyed Jia Baoyu's instructions to Qingwen, who is waiting at Yihong Court.
texts.席间，贾母说明贾府进项日益减少，庄园租金难以收回，拟将缀锦楼和含芳阁等几处空院典: During the meal, Grandmother Jia explained that the Jia household's income was steadily decreasing, estate rents were difficult to collect, and she proposed mortgaging several vacant courtyards, including Zhuijin Tower and Hanfang Pavilion, to obtain silver for cash flow.
texts.平儿、晴雯与袭人三人已分头仔细查找被寻找的人。: Ping'er, Qingwen, and Xiren have split up and are carefully searching for Jia Baoyu.
texts.平儿、晴雯与袭人即刻分头仔细搜寻贾宝玉，并须在三刻钟内向贾政回禀结果。: Ping'er, Qingwen, and Xiren immediately split up to carefully search for Jia Baoyu and must report the results to Jia Zheng within three quarters of an hour.
texts.平儿交代袭人，若三刻钟内未找到贾宝玉，必须回禀平儿。: Ping'er instructed Xiren that if Jia Baoyu is not found within three quarters of an hour, Xiren must report back to Ping'er.
texts.平儿向茗烟和贾环通报，贾政命令召贾宝玉到贾政的书房。: Ping'er informed Mingyan and Jia Huan that Jia Zheng ordered that Jia Baoyu be summoned to Jia Zheng's study.
texts.平儿向贾政回报已按贾政吩咐部署寻找贾宝玉。: Ping'er reported to Jia Zheng that she had deployed the search for Jia Baoyu as he instructed.
texts.平儿向贾政回报说她已按贾政的吩咐部署搜寻工作。: Ping'er reported to Jia Zheng that she had arranged the search work as he instructed.
texts.平儿向贾政回禀，按分工已在怡红院门外、门廊、后院、柴房、贮物间、楼梯下、偏院、假: Ping'er reported to Jia Zheng that, as assigned, they had searched outside the gate of Yihong Court, the verandah, the rear yard, the woodshed, the storage room, under the stairs, the side courtyard, the artificial rockery, and the garden.
texts.平儿向贾政询问，是否现在将搜寻范围扩大至潇湘馆、逗蜂轩等处，或贾政有其他吩咐。: Ping'er asked Jia Zheng whether to expand the search now to Xiaoxiang Pavilion, Doufeng Pavilion, and the like, or whether Jia Zheng had other instructions.
texts.平儿告知袭人，若在搜寻中见到贾宝玉，应立即送贾宝玉到贾政的书房。: Ping'er told Xiren that if she encountered Jia Baoyu during the search, she should immediately take Jia Baoyu to Jia Zheng's study.
texts.平儿告诉茗烟和贾环，贾政询问他们是否知道贾宝玉的下落。: Ping'er told Mingyan and Jia Huan that Jia Zheng asked them whether they knew Jia Baoyu's whereabouts.
texts.平儿在门廊与院外寻找贾宝玉。: Ping'er searched for Jia Baoyu in the verandah and outside the courtyard.
texts.平儿对茗烟询问王熙凤小姐最近有何吩咐，并表示自己会替王熙凤小姐打点府中事务。: Ping'er asked Mingyan whether Miss Wang Xifeng had any recent instructions and said she would handle household affairs on Miss Wang Xifeng's behalf.
texts.平儿指示袭人逐查怡红院后院和藏间的柴房、贮物间、楼梯下等隐蔽处。: Ping'er instructed Xiren to check in turn the back yard of Yihong Court and hidden places such as the woodshed, the storage room, and under the stairs.
texts.平儿表示自己不知道贾宝玉的下落。: Ping'er stated that she did not know Jia Baoyu's whereabouts.
texts.平儿要求袭人把贾宝玉送到贾政书房后，当面督促贾宝玉读书守礼。: Ping'er requested that after Xiren brought Jia Baoyu to Jia Zheng's study, she should personally urge Jia Baoyu to study and observe proper manners.
texts.幸夫人决定熬一锅蔬菜粥作为家宴的主食。: Madam Xing decided to cook a pot of vegetable congee as the main dish for the family meal.
texts.幸夫人准备搭配几样咸菜和少量荤菜以迎合贾赦的口味。: Lady Xing prepared a few salted vegetables and a small amount of meat dishes to suit Jia She's taste.
texts.幸夫人命令婢女守在门口恭候贾赦到来。: Lady Xing ordered a maid to wait at the door to receive Jia She.
texts.幸夫人在贾赦院整理厨房并准备食材。: Lady Xing organized the kitchen in Jia She's compound and prepared ingredients.
texts.幸夫人整理了门庭的布置以准备迎接贾赦。: Lady Xing arranged the entrance and courtyard to prepare for Jia She's arrival.
texts.幸夫人精打细算所需用料并拟定了替代方案以节省食材。: Lady Xing carefully calculated the required ingredients and devised alternatives to save food.
texts.幸夫人计划在贾赦回府时将准备好的家宴端上桌。: Lady Xing planned to serve the prepared family meal when Jia She returned to the residence.
texts.府中已为姥姥备好了被褥与热水。: The household had already prepared bedding and hot water for the maternal grandmother.
texts.悄悄靠近贾政，站在不引人注意的角落观察他的表情与言行。: Quietly approach Jia Zheng and stand in an unobtrusive corner to observe his expressions and behavior.
texts.掀开湘帘，进潇湘馆林黛玉房中查看小姐是否安好并在旁照料: Lift the Xiang curtain, enter Lin Daiyu's room in Xiaoxiang Lodge to check whether the young lady is all right and attend to her.
texts.整理厨房并备料，拟今日节俭家宴：熬蔬菜粥、配几样咸菜与少量荤菜以合贾赦口味；精打: Clean the kitchen and prepare ingredients, plan today's frugal family meal: simmer vegetable porridge, serve a few salted vegetables and a small amount of meat dishes to suit Jia She's taste; carefully calculate the ingredients and
texts.晴雯向平儿回报，晴雯已按分工仔细查寻怡红院的偏院、假山与花园。: Qingwen reported to Ping'er that she had, according to the division of labor, carefully searched the side courtyards, the rockery, and the garden of Yihong Court.
texts.晴雯回复说晴雯已收到贾政的吩咐。: Qingwen replied that she had received Jia Zheng's instructions.
texts.晴雯在偏院、假山与花园负责搜寻。: Qingwen was assigned to search the side courtyard, the rockery, and the garden.
texts.晴雯在怡红院向袭人回报：晴雯已按分工仔细查看偏院、假山与花园。: Qingwen reported to Xi Ren in Yihong Court that she had, as assigned, carefully inspected the side courtyard, the rockery, and the garden.
texts.晴雯在怡红院向袭人承诺：若有任何关于贾宝玉的消息，晴雯会立即回报袭人。: In Yihong Court Qingwen promised Xi Ren that if there were any news about Jia Baoyu she would immediately report it to Xi Ren.
texts.晴雯在怡红院对袭人回报：她不清楚贾宝玉现在在哪里，愿意去大观园和书房等处打听贾宝: Qingwen reported to Xi Ren in Yihong Court that she did not know where Jia Baoyu was now and was willing to inquire about his whereabouts at the Grand View Garden and at the study.
texts.晴雯对莺儿表示愿意替莺儿去薛家或大观楼等处打听薛宝钗的下落，并承诺有音信会立刻来: Qingwen told Ying'er she was willing to go to the Xue residence or the Grand View Tower to inquire after Xue Baochai's whereabouts and promised to report back immediately if she had any news.
texts.晴雯接下来将顺路去大观楼与贾政书房再打听贾宝玉的下落。: Qingwen said she would next, en route, go to the Grand View Tower and Jia Zheng's study to inquire further about Jia Baoyu's whereabouts.
texts.晴雯表示晴雯与袭人、平儿已分头在怡红院及其周围寻找贾宝玉。: Qingwen said that she, Xi Ren, and Ping'er had split up to search for Jia Baoyu in and around Yihong Court.
texts.晴雯表示若有人找到贾宝玉，应立即把贾宝玉送到贾政的书房。: Qingwen said that if anyone found Jia Baoyu they should immediately bring him to Jia Zheng's study.
texts.李纨在曲栏旁协助点评众人诗作，站在曲栏旁帮助各位姝女修改与评判诗句。: Li Wan, beside the curved balustrade, assisted in commenting on everyone's poems, standing by the railing to help the young women revise and judge lines.
texts.李纨在聚会上示范吟诵了两句海棠题诗。: At the gathering Li Wan demonstrated by reciting two lines of a begonia-themed poem.
texts.李纨在蘅芜苑主持海棠诗社的聚会。: Li Wan presided over the begonia poetry club meeting in Hengwu Garden.
texts.李纨在蘅芜苑召集并主持大观园诗社的聚会。: Li Wan convened and presided over the Grand View Garden poetry society meeting in Hengwu Garden.
texts.李纨在蘅芜苑对林黛玉以海棠为题的诗作作出评点。: Li Wan commented on Lin Daiyu's begonia-themed poem in Hengwu Garden.
texts.李纨在蘅芜苑对贾惜春以海棠为题的诗作作出评点。: Li Wan commented on Jia Xichun's begonia-themed poem in Hengwu Garden.
texts.李纨在蘅芜苑建议在该续作末句留一字以增余韵。: Li Wan suggested in Hengwu Garden leaving one character at the end of the continuation to add lingering rhyme.
texts.李纨在蘅芜苑建议将贾惜春诗次句中的“浮动”一词改为“飘入”。: Li Wan suggested in Hengwu Garden changing the word 浮动 to 飘入 in the second line of Jia Xichun's poem.
texts.李纨在蘅芜苑建议将首句中的“梦亦香”微润为“梦初香”。: Li Wan suggested in Hengwu Garden slightly alter the first line's 梦亦香 to 梦初香.
texts.李纨在蘅芜苑的聚会上评点了贾探春、贾惜春、林黛玉及其他在场的女诗人所作的海棠题诗: At the Hengwu Garden gathering Li Wan critiqued the begonia-themed poems by Jia Tanchun, Jia Xichun, Lin Daiyu, and the other women poets present.
texts.李纨在蘅芜苑的聚会中为在场的众姝引座并安排她们就坐。: Li Wan escorted the young women present to their seats and arranged their seating at the gathering in Hengwu Garden.
texts.李纨在蘅芜苑称该续作次句“细影摇红入帘长”写影入帘、回味悠长。: At Hengwu Garden, Li Wan said the sequel's second line "细影摇红入帘长" depicts shadows entering the curtain and leaves a lingering aftertaste.
texts.李纨在蘅芜苑称该续作首句“海棠浓处梦亦香”将花与梦相联，意境朦胧。: At Hengwu Garden, Li Wan said the sequel's first line "海棠浓处梦亦香" links flower and dream and creates a hazy mood.
texts.李纨在蘅芜苑请贾惜春笑纳李纨的评点。: At Hengwu Garden, Li Wan asked Jia Xichun to accept Li Wan's remarks with a smile.
texts.李纨在评点时慰问林黛玉近况，关切林黛玉的身体与情绪。: While giving comments, Li Wan inquired after Lin Daiyu's recent condition, expressing concern about Lin Daiyu's health and mood.
texts.李纨建议在林黛玉的末句留一字以增添余韵。: Li Wan suggested leaving one word at the end of Lin Daiyu's final line to add lingering resonance.
texts.李纨建议在贾惜春诗的末句留一字以增添余韵。: Li Wan suggested leaving one word at the end of Jia Xichun's poem to increase lingering resonance.
texts.李纨建议将林黛玉诗中的“香尘”改为“残香”以改善用词。: Li Wan suggested changing "香尘" in Lin Daiyu's poem to "残香" to improve the diction.
texts.李纨建议将林黛玉诗中的「香尘」改为「残香」或在末句留一字以增余韵。: Li Wan suggested either changing "香尘" in Lin Daiyu's poem to "残香" or leaving one word at the end of the final line to add resonance.
texts.李纨建议将贾探春诗句中的“落香迟”改作“残香迟”作为另一种修改建议。: Li Wan suggested changing "落香迟" in Jia Tanchun's line to "残香迟" as an alternative revision.
texts.李纨建议将贾探春诗句中的“落香迟”改作“香更迟”。: Li Wan suggested changing "落香迟" in Jia Tanchun's line to "香更迟".
texts.李纨建议用“残香”一词来渲染贾惜春诗中的离思意境。: Li Wan suggested using the word "残香" to evoke a mood of parting in Jia Xichun's poem.
texts.李纨愿意代替贾芸去袭人处寻找小红，并表示可以将小红带回或指点去怡红院的路。: Li Wan offered to go to Xiren on behalf of Jia Yun to look for Xiao Hong, saying she could either bring Xiao Hong back or show her the way to Yihong Court.
texts.李纨或建议将贾探春诗的末句改为“与谁共知”。: Li Wan suggested changing the final line of Jia Tanchun's poem to "与谁共知".
texts.李纨称林黛玉诗次句“细雨轻拂落香尘”风致悠长。: Li Wan said Lin Daiyu's second line "细雨轻拂落香尘" has a lingering grace.
texts.李纨称林黛玉诗首句「海棠恰似晓妆匀」的喻兴得当。: Li Wan said Lin Daiyu's first line "海棠恰似晓妆匀" uses an apt metaphor.
texts.李纨称贾惜春诗的次句“淡香浮动入帘前”意境恰当。: Li Wan said Jia Xichun's second line "淡香浮动入帘前" carries a fitting mood.
texts.李纨称贾惜春诗的首句“海棠半含春睡眼”写出花带羞态。: Li Wan said Jia Xichun's first line "海棠半含春睡眼" depicts the flower's shy expression.
texts.李纨称贾探春的第三句和第四句承接得当。: Li Wan said Jia Tanchun's third and fourth lines connect properly.
texts.李纨称贾探春首句“海棠半掩春深处”将花静态融入景物，立意沉稳。: Li Wan said Jia Tanchun's first line "海棠半掩春深处" integrates the flower's stillness into the scene, giving a steady tone.
texts.李纨认为贾探春次句“细雨摇红落香迟”写雨拂花、香气迟到，意致幽远。: Li Wan thought Jia Tanchun's second line "细雨摇红落香迟" depicts rain brushing the flowers and the fragrance arriving late, producing a subtle, distant sentiment.
texts.李纨评价林黛玉诗次句「细雨轻拂落香尘」风致纤巧。: Li Wan commented that Lin Daiyu's second line "细雨轻拂落香尘" has delicate charm.
texts.李纨请史湘云就座，并请史湘云续吟或对海棠题诗作评点。: Li Wan invited Shi Xiangyun to take a seat and asked her to continue reciting or to comment on the begonia poems.
texts.李纨请蘅芜苑中的诸姝对贾探春的诗作指正。: Li Wan asked the young women in Hengwu Garden to point out corrections to Jia Tanchun's poem.
texts.李纨请诸姐妹在蘅芜苑共同商议对林黛玉诗的修改意见。: Li Wan asked the sisters in Hengwu Garden to discuss together revisions for Lin Daiyu's poem.
texts.李纨邀请贾探春、贾惜春、贾迎春、林黛玉和史湘云参加蘅芜苑的大观园诗社聚会。: Li Wan invited Jia Tanchun, Jia Xichun, Jia Yingchun, Lin Daiyu, and Shi Xiangyun to attend the Grand View Garden poetry society gathering at Hengwu Garden.
texts.板儿向府中承诺，若遇到来客或有新鲜风闻便立刻回禀。: Ban'er promised the household that if guests arrived or there was fresh news, she would report back immediately.
texts.板儿向贾琏承诺，板儿会立刻将所记下的来访与谈话记录回禀贾琏。: Ban'er promised Jia Lian that she would immediately report to him the visits and conversations she had recorded.
texts.板儿向贾琏等荣国府的人请求赐饭食或允许刘姥姥在荣国府过夜。: Ban'er asked Jia Lian and others of Rongguo House to give food or to allow Granny Liu to stay overnight at Rongguo House.
texts.板儿在荣国府向贾琏和贾芸道谢。: Ban'er thanked Jia Lian and Jia Yun at Rongguo House.
texts.板儿在荣国府向贾琏回报，姥姥已先吃了点热饭暖身。: Ban'er reported to Jia Lian at Rongguo Mansion that Granny Liu had already eaten some hot food to warm herself.
texts.板儿在荣国府向贾琏回报，姥姥已安置在里屋。: Ban'er reported to Jia Lian at Rongguo Mansion that Granny Liu had been settled in the inner room.
texts.板儿在荣国府向贾琏回报：姥姥与板儿在荣国府里屋候食。: Ban'er reported to Jia Lian at Rongguo Mansion: Granny Liu and Ban'er are waiting for food in the mansion's inner room.
texts.板儿在荣国府向贾琏回报：目前府中暂未见贾母、贾政、贾赦或商人和官宦来往。: Ban'er reported to Jia Lian at Rongguo Mansion that at present the household had not seen Grandmother Jia, Jia Zheng, or Jia She, nor merchants or officials coming or going.
texts.板儿在荣国府向贾琏回报：眼下府中亦未见商贾或官宦上门。: Ban'er reported to Jia Lian at Rongguo Mansion that currently no merchants or officials had called at the residence.
texts.板儿在荣国府向贾琏回报：眼下府中暂时未见贾母、贾政、贾赦来往。: Ban'er reported to Jia Lian at Rongguo Mansion that for the time being the household had not seen Grandmother Jia, Jia Zheng, or Jia She coming or going.
texts.板儿在荣国府向贾琏询问何时能备好饭食。: Ban'er asked Jia Lian at Rongguo Mansion when the meal could be prepared.
texts.板儿在荣国府向贾琏询问姥姥可在府中何处落脚。: Ban'er asked Jia Lian at Rongguo Mansion where Granny Liu could be lodged in the house.
texts.板儿在荣国府告诉贾琏和贾芸，厨房约半刻钟就会送来饭食。: Ban'er told Jia Lian and Jia Yun at Rongguo Mansion that the kitchen would send the food in about half a ke (about 7–8 minutes).
texts.板儿在荣国府对薛蟠承诺日后若有空板儿一定会随同薛蟠上街。: Ban'er promised Xue Pan at Rongguo Mansion that in future, if she had free time, she would accompany Xue Pan into town.
texts.板儿在荣国府请求薛蟠体谅板儿留在府中照顾姥姥的决定。: Ban'er asked Xue Pan to understand her decision to remain at the mansion to look after Granny Liu.
texts.板儿将留在贾府中照料姥姥。: Ban'er will stay in the Jia household to care for Granny Liu.
texts.板儿承诺若薛蟠回府带客或喧闹，板儿会立即向贾琏回报。: Ban'er promised that if Xue Pan returned to the household with guests or caused a disturbance, she would immediately report it to Jia Lian.
texts.板儿表示愿意为贾琏和荣国府在场的其他人跑腿以表谢意。: Ban'er expressed willingness to run errands for Jia Lian and the others present at Rongguo Mansion to show her thanks.
texts.板儿遵贾琏之命表示，若有街坊、差役或信使来访，板儿会记下来访人的姓名、来意与所说: Following Jia Lian's orders, Ban'er said that if neighbors, low-ranking officials or messengers visited, she would note the visitor's name, purpose, and what they said.
texts.板儿随姥姥刘姥姥进入荣国府。: Ban'er accompanied Granny Liu into Rongguo Mansion.
texts.林黛玉不在大观楼。: Lin Daiyu is not at the Grand View Pavilion.
texts.林黛玉与在场诸人共同评点诗句，彼此评论并相互应和称赏。: Lin Daiyu and those present critiqued and praised verses together, commenting and responding to one another.
texts.林黛玉在海棠诗社即席赋句数阕，现场即兴作了几阕海棠诗句。: At the Begonia Poetry Club, Lin Daiyu spontaneously composed several stanzas on the spot.
texts.林黛玉在潇湘馆。: Lin Daiyu is at Xiaoxiang Lodge.
texts.林黛玉在聚会当众将诗句中的“香尘”改为“残香”。: At the gathering, Lin Daiyu publicly changed the phrase '香尘' to '残香' in a poem.
texts.林黛玉在聚会当众续出诗句“海棠残香半入帘，疏影摇风似旧年”。: At the gathering, Lin Daiyu continued with the lines: "The begonia's lingering scent half enters the curtain; sparse shadows sway in the wind like old years."
texts.林黛玉在蘅芜苑参加由贾探春发起的海棠诗社小聚。: Lin Daiyu attended the Begonia Poetry Club gathering in Hengwu Garden initiated by Jia Tanchun.
texts.林黛玉在蘅芜苑海棠诗社小聚中续吟道：“海棠影里人初醉，风送幽香入梦回。”: At the Begonia Poetry Club gathering in Hengwu Garden, Lin Daiyu continued: "In the begonia's shade the person grows newly intoxicated; the wind sends the faint scent into a returning dream."
texts.林黛玉表示她愿意陪同贾芸去寻找小红。: Lin Daiyu said she was willing to accompany Jia Yun to look for Xiao Hong.
texts.玉钏儿向王夫人回禀说：薛姨妈与薛姨妈的子女已在内宅暂住。: Yuchun'er reported to Lady Wang that Aunt Xue and Aunt Xue's children were temporarily staying in the inner residence.
texts.玉钏儿向王夫人回禀说：贾母（贾府的老夫人）院子里无人。: Yuchun'er reported to Lady Wang that there was no one in Grandmother Jia's (the Jia household's matriarch) courtyard.
texts.玉钏儿在王夫人处为薛宝钗准备了一间住处。: Yuchun'er prepared a room for Xue Baochai at Lady Wang's.
texts.玉钏儿在王夫人处为薛蟠准备了一间住处。: Yuchun'er prepared a room for Xue Pan at Lady Wang's.
texts.玉钏儿在王夫人处先为薛姨妈的孩子们备好了席褥。: Yuchun'er, at Lady Wang's residence, first prepared bedding and mats for Aunt Xue's children.
texts.王夫人、王熙凤与贾母会同商定有关典押的具体细节。: Lady Wang, Wang Xifeng, and Grandmother Jia together discussed and decided the specific details regarding the pawning.
texts.王夫人吩咐为薛蟠和薛宝钗各准备一间住处，待王夫人过目后再行安置。: Lady Wang ordered that a separate room be prepared for Xue Pan and another for Xue Baochai, to be arranged after Lady Wang inspects them.
texts.王夫人吩咐玉钏儿先带薛姨妈进入王府暂住。: Lady Wang instructed Yuchun'er to first bring Aunt Xue into the Wang residence to stay temporarily.
texts.王夫人嘱咐薛姨妈如果有需要或有索求要立即说明。: Lady Wang told Aunt Xue to state immediately if she had any needs or requests.
texts.王夫人在藕香榭下令，藕香榭的丫鬟们须妥为侍候贾宝玉。: At the Lotus Fragrance Pavilion, Lady Wang ordered the pavilion's maids to properly attend to Jia Baoyu.
texts.王夫人已派人逐一前往花袭人处传达王夫人的旨意。: Lady Wang sent people one by one to Hua Xiren's place to convey Lady Wang's instructions.
texts.王夫人得知贾宝玉今日到花袭人家中。: Lady Wang learned that Jia Baoyu went to Hua Xiren's home today.
texts.王夫人指示：花袭人或首席丫鬟今夜每两时向王夫人处口头或书面报到一次，亲自督促并确: Lady Wang instructed that Hua Xiren or the chief maid must report verbally or in writing to Lady Wang once every two hours tonight, and personally supervise and confirm that Jia Baoyu has taken his medicine on time.
texts.王熙凤吩咐闲散的人速退离开荣庆堂。: Wang Xifeng ordered idle people to withdraw quickly from Rongqing Hall.
texts.王熙凤命令贾蓉与贾珍等人迅速退下。: Wang Xifeng commanded Jia Rong, Jia Zhen, and others to leave immediately.
texts.王熙凤嘱咐小红转告晴雯：贾宝玉仍在贾母身侧，众人不得打扰正厅。: Wang Xifeng asked Xiaohong to tell Qingwen that Jia Baoyu is still at Grandmother Jia's side and that no one may disturb the main hall.
texts.王熙凤嘱咐贾宝玉必须留在贾母身侧恭候，不得离席。: Wang Xifeng told Jia Baoyu he must remain at Grandmother Jia's side to wait respectfully and must not leave his seat.
texts.王熙凤在大观楼向众人传达了贾母的旨意。: At the Grand View Pavilion, Wang Xifeng conveyed Grandmother Jia's orders to everyone.
texts.王熙凤在大观楼命令贾珍，吩咐薛姨妈在大观楼外候着，不在贾母身旁伺候。: At the Grand View Pavilion, Wang Xifeng ordered Jia Zhen to tell Aunt Xue to wait outside the Grand View Pavilion and not to serve at Grandmother Jia's side.
texts.王熙凤在大观楼命令贾珍，吩咐贾珍忙完这些事后回来向王熙凤禀报。: At the Grand View Pavilion, Wang Xifeng ordered Jia Zhen to return and report to Wang Xifeng after finishing those tasks.
texts.王熙凤在大观楼命贾蓉和贾珍备上热茶。: At the Grand View Pavilion, Wang Xifeng ordered Jia Rong and Jia Zhen to prepare hot tea.
texts.王熙凤在大观楼命贾蓉和贾珍备上茶点。: At the Grand View Pavilion, Wang Xifeng ordered Jia Rong and Jia Zhen to prepare tea snacks.
texts.王熙凤在大观楼命贾蓉和贾珍立刻把正厅收拾干净。: At the Grand View Pavilion, Wang Xifeng ordered Jia Rong and Jia Zhen to immediately clean up the main hall.
texts.王熙凤在大观楼安排席次并传达贾母的旨意。: At the Grand View Pavilion, Wang Xifeng arranged the seating and conveyed Grandmother Jia's orders.
texts.王熙凤在大观楼对刘姥姥表示，如果刘姥姥需要，王熙凤会立刻吩咐人去后厨为刘姥姥取两: At the Grand View Pavilion, Wang Xifeng told Granny Liu that if she needed it, Wang Xifeng would immediately order someone to fetch two plates of hometown candies for Granny Liu from the kitchen.
texts.王熙凤在大观楼对刘姥姥说，让刘姥姥先落座。: At the Grand View Pavilion, Wang Xifeng told Granny Liu to take a seat first.
texts.王熙凤在大观楼当场下令众人退下。: At the Grand View Pavilion, Wang Xifeng ordered everyone to withdraw on the spot.
texts.王熙凤在大观楼当着众人通报并安排接下来的事宜。: At the Grand View Pavilion, Wang Xifeng publicly announced and arranged the forthcoming matters.
texts.王熙凤在大观楼要求贾蓉和贾珍将座位按长幼顺序摆放。: At the Grand View Pavilion, Wang Xifeng required Jia Rong and Jia Zhen to arrange the seats in order of seniority and age.
texts.王熙凤在荣庆堂按照贾母的旨意安排席位。: In Rongqing Hall, Wang Xifeng arranged the seating according to Grandmother Jia's orders.
texts.王熙凤安排刘姥姥坐在贾母近侧。: Wang Xifeng arranged for Granny Liu to sit near Grandmother Jia.
texts.王熙凤已吩咐下人催促，要求速请林黛玉到大观楼并让林黛玉尽快返回。: Wang Xifeng instructed servants to hasten and summon Lin Daiyu to the Grand View Pavilion and to have Lin Daiyu return as soon as possible.
texts.王熙凤当众指示贾蓉和贾珍即刻收拾正厅并备茶点。: Wang Xifeng publicly instructed Jia Rong and Jia Zhen to immediately tidy the main hall and prepare tea snacks.
texts.王熙凤指定贾母为席次首位。: Wang Xifeng designated Grandmother Jia as the first seat in the seating order.
texts.王熙凤指示贾宝玉在贾母右侧就座。: Wang Xifeng instructed Jia Baoyu to sit at Grandmother Jia's right side.
texts.王熙凤派人去请林黛玉到贾母跟前。: Wang Xifeng sent someone to invite Lin Daiyu to Grandmother Jia's side.
texts.王熙凤派出快手丫鬟连声催请林黛玉入内。: Wang Xifeng sent a quick-handed maid to repeatedly urge Lin Daiyu to come in.
texts.紫鹃向茗烟报告说贾宝玉在潇湘馆。: Zijuan reported to Mingyan that Jia Baoyu was at Xiaoxiang Pavilion.
texts.紫鹃向贾蓉与茗烟回禀，报告贾宝玉在潇湘馆。: Zijuan reported to Jia Rong and Mingyan that Jia Baoyu was at Xiaoxiang Pavilion.
texts.紫鹃向贾蓉回报：大观楼当前在场的人有贾蓉和茗烟。: Zijuan reported to Jia Rong that the people currently present at the Grand View Tower were Jia Rong and Mingyan.
texts.紫鹃告诉茗烟，贾宝玉方才进来见了林黛玉。: Zijuan told Mingyan that Jia Baoyu had just come in to see Lin Daiyu.
texts.紫鹃告诉茗烟，贾宝玉正坐在林黛玉的床边。: Zijuan told Mingyan that Jia Baoyu was sitting at Lin Daiyu's bedside.
texts.紫鹃回禀说她已进入潇湘馆并请得贾宝玉。: Zijuan reported that she had entered Xiaoxiang Pavilion and had brought Jia Baoyu.
texts.紫鹃回禀：大观楼正厅当前在场者为贾蓉一人，暂未见他人到达或离去，亦无突发状况。: Zijuan reported: the main hall of the Grand View Tower currently had only Jia Rong present; no one else had arrived or departed, and there were no unexpected incidents.
texts.紫鹃在潇湘馆为检查林黛玉的状况查看林黛玉的呼吸与脉搏。: At Xiaoxiang Pavilion, Zijuan checked Lin Daiyu's breathing and pulse to assess her condition.
texts.紫鹃在潇湘馆劝林黛玉少言多卧，休息更多。: At Xiaoxiang Pavilion, Zijuan urged Lin Daiyu to speak less and rest more.
texts.紫鹃在潇湘馆床边整理林黛玉的衣被，并为林黛玉端来温开水。: At Xiaoxiang Pavilion, Zijuan tidied Lin Daiyu's clothing and bedding at her bedside and brought her warm water.
texts.紫鹃在潇湘馆床边观察林黛玉的呼吸与面色。: At Xiaoxiang Pavilion, Zijuan observed Lin Daiyu's breathing and complexion at her bedside.
texts.紫鹃在潇湘馆床边静坐守护林黛玉。: At Xiaoxiang Pavilion, Zijuan sat quietly at Lin Daiyu's bedside to keep watch.
texts.紫鹃在潇湘馆把药茶递给林黛玉。: At Xiaoxiang Pavilion, Zijuan handed Lin Daiyu a medicinal tea.
texts.紫鹃在潇湘馆掀开林黛玉的被子检查林黛玉的脸色。: At Xiaoxiang Pavilion, Zijuan lifted Lin Daiyu's cover to check her complexion.
texts.紫鹃在潇湘馆替林黛玉拭额，擦去林黛玉的额汗。: At Xiaoxiang Pavilion, Zijuan wiped Lin Daiyu's forehead, removing her sweat.
texts.紫鹃在潇湘馆替林黛玉整理枕被，摆好枕头与被褥。: At Xiaoxiang Pavilion, Zijuan arranged Lin Daiyu's pillow and bedding, setting them properly.
texts.紫鹃将继续陪护林黛玉，并等候二爷的吩咐，以决定是否请太医或回禀大观楼。: Zijuan would continue to accompany Lin Daiyu and await the Second Master's instructions to decide whether to summon the imperial physician or report to the Grand View Tower.
texts.紫鹃将马上带贾宝玉去书房，奉命守礼。: Zijuan would immediately take Jia Baoyu to the study, as ordered, observing proper etiquette.
texts.紫鹃已备薄粥给林黛玉。: Zijuan had prepared thin porridge for Lin Daiyu.
texts.紫鹃承诺她将即刻前往潇湘馆请回贾宝玉。: Zijuan promised she would immediately go to Xiaoxiang Pavilion to fetch Jia Baoyu.
texts.紫鹃承诺如果前往贾政书房的路上发生变化，她将立即返回并回禀报告情况。: Zijuan promised that if anything changed on the way to Jia Zheng's study, she would immediately return and report the situation.
texts.紫鹃承诺如果途中有耽搁或阻滞，她会速回禀贾蓉与茗烟。: Zijuan promised that if there were delays or obstructions en route, she would quickly return and report to Jia Rong and Mingyan.
texts.紫鹃报告紫鹃将去请贾宝玉。: Zijuan reported that she would go to fetch Jia Baoyu.
texts.花袭人及其家人亲自护送并照看贾宝玉。: Hua Xiren and her family personally escorted and looked after Jia Baoyu.
texts.花袭人及其家人亲自招待贾宝玉。: Hua Xiren and her family personally entertained Jia Baoyu.
texts.花袭人及其家人未见贾宝玉发热、皮疹或拒服药等异常情况。: Hua Xiren and her family did not observe any abnormal signs such as Jia Baoyu having a fever, rashes, or refusing to take medicine.
texts.若三人中有人发现被寻找的人，他们将立刻把该人送到贾政的书房。: If any of the three people finds the person being sought, they will immediately bring that person to Jia Zheng's study.
texts.若三人发现贾宝玉，三人必须立即将贾宝玉送到贾政的书房。: If the three find Jia Baoyu, the three must immediately bring Jia Baoyu to Jia Zheng's study.
texts.若三刻钟内没有所得，三人将向贾政回禀。: If nothing is obtained within forty-five minutes, the three will report back to Jia Zheng.
texts.若人手不足或遇特殊情况，命立即回禀贾政以便再调派人手。: If manpower is insufficient or special circumstances arise, they must immediately report to Jia Zheng so additional personnel can be assigned.
texts.若有人来访，板儿会记录来访者的姓名、来意与所说内容并立即回禀府中主人。: If someone visits, Ban'er will record the visitor's name, purpose, and statements and immediately inform the master of the household.
texts.若林黛玉出现异样，紫鹃会在潇湘馆立刻唤贾蓉并迅速请太医来诊治林黛玉。: If Lin Daiyu shows signs of illness, Zijuan at Xiaoxiang Pavilion will immediately call Jia Rong and quickly summon the imperial physician to treat Lin Daiyu.
texts.若林黛玉有异样，紫鹃会唤贾宝玉并速请太医。: If Lin Daiyu is unwell, Zijuan will summon Jia Baoyu and quickly summon the imperial physician.
texts.若薛蟠邀请板儿出外，板儿将婉言谢绝出门。: If Xue Pan invites Ban'er to go out, Ban'er will politely decline to go out.
texts.若见到贾宝玉，命立即把贾宝玉送到贾政的书房并当面督促贾宝玉读书守礼并回禀贾政。: If Jia Baoyu is seen, they are ordered to immediately take Jia Baoyu to Jia Zheng's study, personally urge Jia Baoyu to study and observe proper manners, and report back to Jia Zheng.
texts.茗烟到潇湘馆和逗蜂轩一带查看贾宝玉是否在那里。: Mingyan will go to Xiaoxiang Pavilion and the area around Doufeng Xuan to check whether Jia Baoyu is there.
texts.茗烟同时吩咐贾蓉，如果在大观楼或路上遇见贾宝玉，务必接应并护送贾宝玉到贾政的书房: Mingyan also instructs Jia Rong that if he meets Jia Baoyu at the Grand View Tower or on the road, he must receive and escort Jia Baoyu to Jia Zheng's study.
texts.茗烟在潇湘馆命令紫鹃马上去请贾宝玉。: At Xiaoxiang Pavilion, Mingyan orders Zijuan to immediately fetch Jia Baoyu.
texts.荣国府的贾琏吩咐厨房准备饭食。: Jia Lian at the Rongguo Mansion ordered the kitchen to prepare food.
texts.莺儿告诉晴雯:她正在为薛宝钗打一只络子,想尽快送去,并询问薛宝钗现在可在何处。: Ying'er told Qingwen that she is making a luozi (a netted pouch) for Xue Baochai, wants to deliver it as soon as possible, and asked where Xue Baochai is now.
texts.莺儿在大观楼向贾母禀报。: Ying'er reported to Grandmother Jia at the Grand View Tower.
texts.莺儿在大观楼并未见到贾宝玉。: Ying'er did not see Jia Baoyu at the Grand View Tower.
texts.莺儿在大观楼荣庆堂将一只络子呈给薛宝钗。: Ying'er presented a luozi (a netted pouch) to Xue Baochai in the Rongqing Hall at the Grand View Tower.
texts.莺儿在怡红院向袭人表示: 她会去打听贾宝玉的去向，并顺路将为薛宝钗打好的络子送到: At Yihongyuan, Ying'er told Xiren she would inquire about Jia Baoyu's whereabouts and, on the way, deliver the luozi she had made for Xue Baochai to Xue Baochai.
texts.莺儿在怡红院向袭人询问，薛宝钗现在在哪里。: At Yihongyuan, Ying'er asked Xiren where Xue Baochai is now.
texts.莺儿在怡红院告诉袭人，莺儿愿意替袭人去打听贾宝玉的去向。: At Yihongyuan, Ying'er told Xiren that she was willing to check Jia Baoyu's whereabouts for Xiren.
texts.莺儿在怡红院对袭人回报，莺儿没有见到贾宝玉。: At Yihongyuan, Ying'er reported to Xiren that she had not seen Jia Baoyu.
texts.莺儿在怡红院对袭人说，莺儿会顺路把络子送给薛宝钗。: At Yihongyuan, Ying'er told Xiren that she would bring the luozi to Xue Baochai on her way.
texts.莺儿愿意去薛家、大观楼和贾政书房继续打听贾宝玉的去向。: Ying'er is willing to go to the Xue residence, the Grand View Tower, and Jia Zheng's study to continue asking about Jia Baoyu's whereabouts.
texts.薛姨妈在王夫人面前恳请王夫人接纳她和她的子女进入贾府。: Aunt Xue pleaded before Lady Wang to accept her and her children into the Jia household.
texts.薛姨妈当面请求王夫人接纳她和她的子女，并恳请王夫人为薛蟠与薛宝钗安排住处。: Aunt Xue asked Lady Wang in person to accept her and her children and begged Lady Wang to arrange lodging for Xue Pan and Xue Baochai.
texts.薛姨妈请求王夫人为薛蟠与薛宝钗安排住处。: Aunt Xue requested that Lady Wang arrange lodging for Xue Pan and Xue Baochai.
texts.薛宝釵已在贾府内宅为自己准备一间住处。: Xue Baochai has already prepared a room for herself in the inner residence of the Jia household.
texts.薛宝钗与王熙凤在大观楼荣庆堂协商安排席位，并商定安置刘姥姥与薛姨妈的座位。: Xue Baochai and Wang Xifeng discussed seating arrangements in the Rongqing Hall of the Grand View Tower and agreed on where to seat Granny Liu and Aunt Xue.
texts.薛宝钗到贾母跟前近前拱手作揖或抱拳向贾母说外祖母请安。: Xue Baochai approached Grandmother Jia, cupped her hands or clasped her fists, and conveyed her maternal grandmother's respects to Grandmother Jia.
texts.薛宝钗吩咐莺儿回莺儿的房间，向房中其他人禀报莺儿已将一只络子呈给薛宝钗的事，并好: Xue Baochai instructed Ying'er to return to Ying'er's room, report to the others there that Ying'er had presented a luozi to Xue Baochai, and then rest.
texts.薛宝钗在大观楼荣庆堂劝说贾宝玉息怒，并请贾宝玉近前向贾母请安就座。: In the Rongqing Hall of the Grand View Tower, Xue Baochai persuaded Jia Baoyu to calm his anger and asked him to come forward to pay respects to Grandmother Jia and sit down.
texts.薛宝钗在大观楼荣庆堂礼貌地接受了这只络子，并称赞了莺儿的手艺。: Xue Baochai politely accepted the luozi in Rongqing Hall of the Grand View Tower and praised Ying'er's handiwork.
texts.薛宝钗在大观楼这里恭候林黛玉。: Xue Baochai is waiting here at the Grand View Tower for Lin Daiyu.
texts.薛宝钗在席间建言，建议暂行将缀锦楼、含芳阁等空置处典出以换取现钱周转。: At the meal Xue Baochai suggested temporarily pawning the vacant Zhuijin Tower, Hanfang Pavilion and similar vacant places to raise cash for circulation.
texts.薛宝钗在席间建言，建议由王夫人和王熙凤等人商定典押期限与价款以免短视亏损。: At the meal Xue Baochai suggested that Lady Wang and Wang Xifeng decide the pawn terms and sums to avoid short-sighted losses.
texts.薛宝钗在席间建言，建议须保留若干自用房屋。: At the meal Xue Baochai suggested that several houses be retained for personal use.
texts.薛宝钗在荣庆堂劝贾宝玉息怒就座。: In Rongqing Hall Xue Baochai urged Jia Baoyu to stop being angry and take his seat.
texts.薛宝钗在荣庆堂劝贾宝玉随她到贾母跟前请安。: In Rongqing Hall Xue Baochai urged Jia Baoyu to go with her to pay respects to Grandmother Jia.
texts.薛宝钗在荣庆堂家宴上对贾母、王夫人、王熙凤及在场众人表示，缀锦楼、含芳阁等空置处: At the family meal in Rongqing Hall Xue Baochai told Grandmother Jia, Lady Wang, Wang Xifeng and those present that the vacant Zhuijin Tower and Hanfang Pavilion could be temporarily pawned to...
texts.薛宝钗在荣庆堂对王熙凤表示，席位之事请王熙凤定夺。: In Rongqing Hall Xue Baochai told Wang Xifeng that the seating arrangement should be decided by Wang Xifeng.
texts.薛宝钗在荣庆堂对王熙凤表示，若需安排刘姥姥或薛姨妈落座，薛宝钗愿意协助办理。: In Rongqing Hall Xue Baochai told Wang Xifeng that if a seat needed to be arranged for Granny Liu or Aunt Xue, Xue Baochai was willing to assist.
texts.薛宝钗在荣庆堂对王熙凤表示，若需引贾宝玉就坐，薛宝钗愿意协助并听候王熙凤的吩咐。: In Rongqing Hall Xue Baochai told Wang Xifeng that if Jia Baoyu needed to be brought to a seat, she would assist and await Wang Xifeng's orders.
texts.薛宝钗在荣庆堂提出典押缀锦楼和含芳阁时必须保留若干自用门面与要害房屋。: In Rongqing Hall Xue Baochai proposed that when pawning the Zhuijin Tower and Hanfang Pavilion, several front rooms and key rooms must be retained for personal use.
texts.薛宝钗在荣庆堂的家宴上对贾母与王熙凤表示她会协助安排刘姥姥落席。: At the family meal in Rongqing Hall Xue Baochai told Grandmother Jia and Wang Xifeng that she would help arrange a seat for Granny Liu.
texts.薛宝钗在荣庆堂的家宴上对贾母与王熙凤表示她会协助安排薛姨妈落席。: At the family meal in Rongqing Hall Xue Baochai told Grandmother Jia and Wang Xifeng that she would help arrange a seat for Aunt Xue.
texts.薛宝钗指示那些丫鬟：如果林黛玉到来，就立即把林黛玉引到贾母跟前。: Xue Baochai instructed the maids that if Lin Daiyu arrived they should at once bring Lin Daiyu to Grandmother Jia.
texts.薛宝钗见林黛玉到来立刻将林黛玉引到贾母跟前。: When Xue Baochai saw Lin Daiyu arrive, she immediately brought Lin Daiyu to Grandmother Jia.
texts.薛宝钗随手协助贾宝玉伺候贾母。: Xue Baochai casually helped Jia Baoyu attend on Grandmother Jia.
texts.薛蟠与薛宝钗各自已有一间住处，席褥已先行备好。: Xue Pan and Xue Baochai each already had a room prepared for them, and mattresses and bedding had been laid out in advance.
texts.薛蟠和薛宝釵已为薛姨妈的孩子们备好席褥。: Xue Pan and Xue Baochai had prepared mattresses and bedding for Aunt Xue's children.
texts.薛蟠在荣国府向板儿和贾琏喊话，邀请两人上街喝酒闹事。: In the Rongguo Mansion Xue Pan called to Ban'er and Jia Lian, inviting them to go out to the street to drink and make a disturbance.
texts.薛蟠已在贾府内宅为自己准备一间住处。: Xue Pan had already prepared a room for himself in the Jia household's inner residence.
texts.薛蟠说他自己去上街，若看到新鲜事就回去向贾琏禀报。: Xue Pan said he would go out to the street and, if he saw anything new, would return to report it to Jia Lian.
texts.藕香榭的丫鬟们须早晚勤察贾宝玉的身体状况。: The maids of the Lotus Fragrance Pavilion must diligently check Jia Baoyu's physical condition morning and evening.
texts.藕香榭的丫鬟已接到王夫人的旨意，并答应向王夫人回禀。: The maids of the Lotus Fragrance Pavilion have received Lady Wang's order and promised to report back to her.
texts.袭人向晴雯询问宝玉在哪里。: Xiren asked Qingwen where Baoyu was.
texts.袭人向贾政回报贾宝玉下落不明的情况并告知正在展开搜寻。: Xiren reported to Jia Zheng that Jia Baoyu's whereabouts were unknown and that a search was underway.
texts.袭人向贾政报告：目前尚未发现贾宝玉。: Xiren reported to Jia Zheng that Jia Baoyu has not yet been found.
texts.袭人嘱咐晴雯和小红：若晴雯或小红有任何消息，晴雯和小红应立即通报袭人。: Xiren told Qingwen and Xiaohong that if either of them had any news they should immediately inform Xiren.
texts.袭人嘱咐莺儿：若莺儿打听到消息或见到贾宝玉，莺儿应立刻返回并将消息告诉袭人。: Xiren told Ying'er that if Ying'er heard any news or saw Jia Baoyu, she should immediately return and tell Xiren.
texts.袭人嘱咐莺儿：若莺儿知道薛宝钗的下落，莺儿应顺路把络子送到薛宝钗那里。: Xiren told Ying'er that if Ying'er knew Xue Baochai's whereabouts, she should on her way deliver the luozi to Xue Baochai.
texts.袭人回报：袭人已向平儿询问门廊和院外的搜查情况，以及对莺儿和晴雯的搜寻进展。: Xiren reports: she has asked Ping'er about the search of the front porch and outside the compound, and about the progress of searching for Ying'er and Qingwen.
texts.袭人在后院与藏间负责搜寻。: Xiren is responsible for searching in the rear courtyard and the storeroom.
texts.袭人承诺立即与小红前往潇湘馆、逗蜂轩、绮散斋书房和大观楼等处仔细查寻贾宝玉。: Xiren promises to go immediately with Xiaohong to Xiaoxiang Pavilion, Doufeng Xuan, the Qisan Zhai study, and the Grand View Pavilion to carefully search for Jia Baoyu.
texts.袭人请示贾政是否立即扩大搜寻范围至潇湘馆与逗蜂轩，或另派人手回报贾宝玉下落。: Xiren asks Jia Zheng whether to immediately expand the search to Xiaoxiang Pavilion and Doufeng Xuan, or to send others to report Jia Baoyu's whereabouts.
texts.袭人负责在怡红院的后院和藏间搜索贾宝玉。: Xiren is assigned to search for Jia Baoyu in the rear courtyard and storeroom of Yihong Court.
texts.袭人还承诺若发现贾宝玉就立刻带到贾政的书房并当面回禀贾政。: Xiren also promises that if she finds Jia Baoyu she will immediately bring him to Jia Zheng's study and report to Jia Zheng in person.
texts.贾元春命令对任何延误或隐瞒信使行踪的人追究责任。: Jia Yuanchun orders that anyone who delays or conceals the messenger's movements be held accountable.
texts.贾元春在凤藻宫吩咐王熙凤代为查问贾府与贾环，确认贾元春所派的信使是否抵达并已呈送: In Fengzao Palace, Jia Yuanchun instructs Wang Xifeng to inquire on her behalf with the Jia household and with Jia Huan to confirm whether the messenger she sent has arrived and delivered a written report.
texts.贾元春在凤藻宫对贾府在场人员贾环发话。: In Fengzao Palace, Jia Yuanchun addresses Jia Huan of the Jia household.
texts.贾元春在凤藻宫指派一名可靠信使，携两封函件分别前往贾府与大观楼。: Jia Yuanchun assigns a reliable messenger to carry two letters, one to the Jia household and one to the Grand View Pavilion.
texts.贾元春在函件中注明回报时限与联络方式，要求贾府和大观楼按时回报并按指定方式联络。: In the letters, Jia Yuanchun specifies the reporting deadline and contact method, requiring the Jia household and the Grand View Pavilion to report on time and use the specified contact method.
texts.贾元春在函件中详列仆役调配与值日表为待办事项，要求贾府和大观楼执行。: In the letters, Jia Yuanchun details servant assignments and the duty roster as items to be done, requiring the Jia household and the Grand View Pavilion to carry them out.
texts.贾元春在函件中详列园中花木修整与布置为待办事项，要求贾府和大观楼执行。: In the letters, Jia Yuanchun details garden plant maintenance and arrangement as an item to be done, requiring the Jia household and the Grand View Pavilion to carry it out.

texts.贾元春规定若信使未到，王熙凤须立即查明该信使的去向并在一刻钟内回报查访结果与初步: Jia Yuanchun stipulates that if the messenger has not arrived, Wang Xifeng must immediately ascertain the messenger's whereabouts and report the investigation results and an initial rectification plan within fifteen minutes.
texts.贾元春询问贾环叙述者所派的信使是否已抵达贾府。: Jia Yuanchun asks Jia Huan whether the messenger sent by the narrator has arrived at the Jia household.
texts.贾宝玉嘱咐小红转告晴雯不要着急。: Jia Baoyu tells Xiaohong to tell Qingwen not to worry.
texts.贾宝玉在大观楼遵从王熙凤的安排。: Jia Baoyu follows Wang Xifeng's arrangements in the Grand View Pavilion.
texts.贾宝玉在贾母右侧恭立伺候。: Jia Baoyu stands respectfully at Grandmother Jia's right side to attend her.
texts.贾宝玉已对王熙凤表示，若贾母有吩咐必恭敬听从并照办。: Jia Baoyu told Wang Xifeng that he would respectfully obey and carry out any orders from Grandmother Jia.
texts.贾宝玉还吩咐其他闲散的人迅速退下，不得在贾母跟前或厅内滞留。: Jia Baoyu also instructed the other idle people to withdraw quickly and not to linger before Grandmother Jia or in the hall.
texts.贾宝玉随薛宝钗到贾母身边就座。: Jia Baoyu followed Xue Baochai to Grandmother Jia's side and sat down.
texts.贾惜春向探春感谢探春设立海棠诗社，并自谦才浅，表示愿意聆听诸姝续吟与评点。: Jia Xichun thanked Jia Tanchun for establishing the Begonia Poetry Society, modestly said her talent was limited, and expressed willingness to listen to the other women continue to compose and comment.
texts.贾惜春在蘅芜苑参加了由贾探春设立的吟社活动。: Jia Xichun attended the poetry gathering founded by Jia Tanchun at Hengwu Garden.
texts.贾惜春在蘅芜苑向贾探春、林黛玉、李纨等人致谢并称近来日常自安，安坐听诸姝评点诗句: At Hengwu Garden Jia Xichun thanked Jia Tanchun, Lin Daiyu, Li Wan and others and said she had been content recently and would sit quietly to listen as the women critiqued lines.
texts.贾惜春在蘅芜苑对贾芸表示，如果丫鬟小红还未被找到，贾惜春愿意随贾芸在蘅芜苑各处打: At Hengwu Garden Jia Xichun told Jia Yun that if the maid Xiao Hong had not yet been found, she was willing to go with Jia Yun around Hengwu Garden to inquire and search.
texts.贾惜春在蘅芜苑的诗社中赋诗，写下“海棠半含春睡眼，淡香浮动入帘前。”。: In the Hengwu Garden poetry society Jia Xichun composed a poem, writing 'The begonia half holds spring's sleepy eyes, faint fragrance drifts before the curtain.'
texts.贾惜春在蘅芜苑续一阕：海棠浓处梦亦香，细影摇红入帘长。: Jia Xichun continued a stanza: 'Where the begonia grows thick, even dreams are fragrant; a thin shadow rocks crimson into the long curtain.'
texts.贾惜春称赞史湘云与林黛玉续写的诗句生动。: Jia Xichun praised Shi Xiangyun and Lin Daiyu's continuations of the lines as vivid.
texts.贾惜春表示愿意洗耳恭听诸位女子继续吟唱并聆听她们的评点。: Jia Xichun said she was willing to listen respectfully as the other women continued to sing and to hear their critiques.
texts.贾惜春还表示可以请史湘云和李纨一同在蘅芜苑帮助寻找丫鬟小红。: Jia Xichun also said she could ask Shi Xiangyun and Li Wan to join her in Hengwu Garden to help search for the maid Xiao Hong.
texts.贾探春、贾惜春、贾迎春、林黛玉和史湘云在蘅芜苑的曲栏处就座。: Jia Tanchun, Jia Xichun, Jia Yingchun, Lin Daiyu and Shi Xiangyun sat at the curved balustrade in Hengwu Garden.
texts.贾探春在蘅芜苑发起并主持了海棠诗社的小聚。: Jia Tanchun initiated and presided over the Begonia Poetry Society's small gathering at Hengwu Garden.
texts.贾探春在蘅芜苑发起并设立了海棠诗社。: Jia Tanchun founded the Begonia Poetry Society at Hengwu Garden.
texts.贾探春在蘅芜苑的海棠诗社小聚上起首吟咏“海棠半掩春深处，细雨摇红落香迟”。: At the Hengwu Garden Begonia Poetry Society gathering Jia Tanchun opened with the line 'The begonia half-hidden in deep spring, fine rain shakes red petals to fall, scent lingers.'
texts.贾探春表示可以先去怡红院查看小红的下落，或者请袭人领路并且可以立即带贾芸前往怡红: Jia Tanchun said she could first go to Yihong Court to check on Xiao Hong's whereabouts, or ask Xiren to lead the way and immediately take Jia Yun there.
texts.贾政下令扩大对贾宝玉的搜寻范围。: Jia Zheng ordered that the search for Jia Baoyu be expanded.
texts.贾政亲自检查怡红院的假山，寻找贾宝玉。: Jia Zheng personally inspected the rockery at Yihong Court looking for Jia Baoyu.
texts.贾政亲自检查怡红院的偏院，寻找贾宝玉。: Jia Zheng personally inspected the side courtyard of Yihong Court looking for Jia Baoyu.
texts.贾政亲自检查怡红院的花园，寻找贾宝玉。: Jia Zheng personally inspected the garden of Yihong Court looking for Jia Baoyu.
texts.贾政亲自检查怡红院的藏间，寻找贾宝玉。: Jia Zheng personally inspected the storeroom at Yihong Court looking for Jia Baoyu.
texts.贾政亲自检查怡红院的门廊，寻找贾宝玉。: Jia Zheng personally inspected the porch at Yihong Court looking for Jia Baoyu.
texts.贾政亲自检查怡红院门外的小道，寻找贾宝玉。: Jia Zheng personally inspected the small path outside Yihong Court looking for Jia Baoyu.
texts.贾政准许现在即刻扩大搜索范围，命人前往大观楼仔细查找。: Jia Zheng authorized immediately expanding the search and ordered people to carefully search the Grand View Tower.
texts.贾政准许现在即刻扩大搜索范围，命人前往潇湘馆仔细查找。: Jia Zheng authorized immediately expanding the search and ordered people to carefully search Xiaoxiang Pavilion.
texts.贾政准许现在即刻扩大搜索范围，命人前往绮散斋书房仔细查找。: Jia Zheng authorized immediately expanding the search and ordered people to carefully search the Qisan Study.
texts.贾政准许现在即刻扩大搜索范围，命人前往逗蜂轩仔细查找。: Jia Zheng authorized immediately expanding the search and ordered people to carefully search Doufeng Pavilion.
texts.贾政召唤贾宝玉到贾政的书房。: Jia Zheng summoned Jia Baoyu to Jia Zheng's study.
texts.贾政叮嘱丫鬟平儿、晴雯和袭人务必督促贾宝玉读书并守礼。: Jia Zheng instructed the maids Ping'er, Qingwen and Xiren to be sure to urge Jia Baoyu to study and to observe proper manners.
texts.贾政命令丫鬟袭人负责搜寻后院与藏间等密处。: Jia Zheng ordered the maid Xiren to search secluded places such as the rear courtyard and storage rooms.
texts.贾政命令贾环与茗烟四处寻找贾宝玉。: Jia Zheng ordered Jia Huan and Mingyan to search everywhere for Jia Baoyu.
texts.贾政在怡红院对丫鬟平儿、晴雯与袭人下达搜寻分工命令。: At Yihong Court, Jia Zheng assigned the maidservants Ping'er, Qingwen, and Xiren specific search duties.
texts.贾政在贾府下令，要求丫鬟平儿、晴雯和袭人立即报告贾宝玉的所在位置。: At the Jia residence, Jia Zheng ordered Ping'er, Qingwen, and Xiren to immediately report Jia Baoyu's whereabouts.
texts.贾政指示平儿、贾环和茗烟分头去寻找贾宝玉。: Jia Zheng instructed Ping'er, Jia Huan, and Mingyan to split up and search for Jia Baoyu.
texts.贾政派平儿与袭人前往大观楼仔细查找贾宝玉。: Jia Zheng sent Ping'er and Xiren to the Grand View Pavilion to search carefully for Jia Baoyu.
texts.贾政派平儿与袭人前往潇湘馆仔细查找贾宝玉。: Jia Zheng sent Ping'er and Xiren to Xiaoxiang Pavilion to search carefully for Jia Baoyu.
texts.贾政派平儿与袭人前往绮散斋书房仔细查找贾宝玉。: Jia Zheng sent Ping'er and Xiren to the Qisan Study to search carefully for Jia Baoyu.
texts.贾政派平儿与袭人前往逗蜂轩仔细查找贾宝玉。: Jia Zheng sent Ping'er and Xiren to Doufeng Pavilion to search carefully for Jia Baoyu.
texts.贾母又吩咐：若无人知情，叫小红立刻回怡红院打听并回来禀报。: Grandmother Jia additionally ordered that if no one knows, Xiao Hong should immediately return to Yihong Court to inquire and report back.
texts.贾母只留下贾宝玉、林黛玉与薛宝钗到贾母身边相见。: Grandmother Jia allowed only Jia Baoyu, Lin Daiyu, and Xue Baochai to remain to see her.
texts.贾母吩咐仆人快去请林黛玉来。: Grandmother Jia instructed the servants to quickly go and fetch Lin Daiyu.
texts.贾母吩咐：若有人见到贾宝玉往何处去，应速禀晴雯并来向贾母禀报。: Grandmother Jia ordered that if anyone sees where Jia Baoyu has gone, they should promptly report to Qingwen and then inform Grandmother Jia.
texts.贾母命在场的闲散人速即退下。: Grandmother Jia ordered the onlookers present to withdraw immediately.
texts.贾母嘱咐薛宝钗与王熙凤安抚贾宝玉。: Grandmother Jia instructed Xue Baochai and Wang Xifeng to calm Jia Baoyu.
texts.贾母在大观楼下命令左右侍从退下。: At the Grand View Pavilion, Grandmother Jia ordered the attendants on both sides to withdraw.
texts.贾母在大观楼交代众人在正厅不要喧扰。: At the Grand View Pavilion, Grandmother Jia told everyone in the main hall not to make noise.
texts.贾母在大观楼叫贾宝玉坐下息怒。: At the Grand View Pavilion, Grandmother Jia told Jia Baoyu to sit down and calm his anger.
texts.贾母在大观楼对众人说外祖母要听真心话。: At the Grand View Pavilion, Grandmother Jia told everyone that the maternal grandmother wants to hear the truth.
texts.贾母在大观楼对众人说这件事情尚未决定。: At the Grand View Pavilion, Grandmother Jia told everyone that this matter has not yet been decided.
texts.贾母在大观楼说要待林黛玉到后，与贾宝玉和薛宝钗私下商议这件事。: At the Grand View Pavilion, Grandmother Jia said she would wait for Lin Daiyu to arrive and then privately discuss the matter with Jia Baoyu and Xue Baochai.
texts.贾母在家宴上嘱咐薛宝钗劝贾宝玉止怒息言，劝贾宝玉平息怒气并少言语。: At the family banquet, Grandmother Jia urged Xue Baochai to persuade Jia Baoyu to stop being angry and to speak less.
texts.贾母在家宴上征询贾宝玉、林黛玉和薛宝钗的真心意见。: At the family banquet, Grandmother Jia asked Jia Baoyu, Lin Daiyu, and Xue Baochai for their sincere opinions.
texts.贾母在荣庆堂命令周围的侍从和闲散人全部退下。: At Rongqing Hall, Grandmother Jia ordered all nearby attendants and onlookers to withdraw.
texts.贾母在荣庆堂声明，缀锦楼和含芳阁等处的典押尚未作出最终决定。: At Rongqing Hall, Grandmother Jia declared that the pawning decisions for Zhuijin Tower and Hanfang Pavilion and other places have not been finally decided.
texts.贾母在荣庆堂屏退左右。: At Rongqing Hall, Grandmother Jia dismissed those at her sides.
texts.贾母在荣庆堂摆下家宴，特意命令贾宝玉、林黛玉和薛宝钗同席。: At Rongqing Hall, Grandmother Jia arranged a family banquet and specifically ordered Jia Baoyu, Lin Daiyu, and Xue Baochai to sit together.
texts.贾母说待林黛玉到场后要与贾宝玉、林黛玉和薛宝钗私下商议。: Grandmother Jia said that after Lin Daiyu arrives she will privately discuss the matter with Jia Baoyu, Lin Daiyu, and Xue Baochai.
texts.贾毓存到贾府拜访：在贾府向贾环致意并请求面晤，询问府中近况（已发出请求消息，尚未: Jia Yucun visited the Jia residence: at the residence he greeted Jia Huan and requested a face-to-face meeting, inquiring about the household's recent condition (a request has been sent; Jia Huan's reply has not yet been received).
texts.贾环回复贾玉存，承蒙来访并约定今日午后于怡红院相见。: Jia Huan replied to Jia Yucun, thanking him for his visit and arranging to meet this afternoon at Yihong Court.
texts.贾环在怡红院的后院和门前各处察看贾宝玉的去向。: Jia Huan searched for Jia Baoyu's whereabouts in the backyard and in front of Yihong Yuan.
texts.贾环表示如贾玉存另有方便的时刻或地点，请回示以便贾环恭候。: Jia Huan said that if Jia Yucun has another convenient time or place, please inform him so that Jia Huan can wait.
texts.贾珍吩咐：事情办成后，快手丫鬟要立刻回到大观楼向在座诸人回禀。: Jia Zhen instructed that when the matter is finished, the swift maid must immediately return to the Grand View Pavilion to report to those present.
texts.贾珍在大观楼向众人禀报外祖母的旨意。: Jia Zhen reported in the Grand View Pavilion to everyone the maternal grandmother's orders.
texts.贾珍已派一名快手丫鬟直奔怡红院，连声催请林黛玉到贾府来。: Jia Zhen sent a swift maid straight to Yihong Yuan, repeatedly urging Lin Daiyu to come to the Jia Mansion.
texts.贾珍指示：若快手丫鬟在前往怡红院途中遇阻滞，应迅速回禀贾珍、贾母、王熙凤、薛宝钗: Jia Zhen instructed that if the swift maid is obstructed on the way to Yihong Yuan, she should promptly report back to Jia Zhen, Grandmother Jia, Wang Xifeng, and Xue Baochai.
texts.贾珍指示：若林黛玉到来，应立刻将林黛玉引到贾母跟前。: Jia Zhen instructed that if Lin Daiyu arrives, she should be immediately brought before Grandmother Jia.
texts.贾琏叮嘱贾芸到稻香村打听小红的下落。: Jia Lian urged Jia Yun to go to Daoxiang Village to inquire about Xiao Hong's whereabouts.
texts.贾琏叮嘱贾芸回府时到怡红院、厨房和贾母处打听小红的下落。: Jia Lian told Jia Yun to ask about Xiao Hong's whereabouts at Yihong Yuan, the kitchen, and Grandmother Jia when he returned to the mansion.
texts.贾琏吩咐厨房在大约半刻功夫内备好饭食并送到里屋。: Jia Lian ordered the kitchen to prepare the meal in about half a ke and send it to the inner room.
texts.贾琏吩咐被派去探问小红下落的人若得消息要立刻向贾琏回禀。: Jia Lian instructed that anyone sent to inquire about Xiao Hong's whereabouts must immediately report back to Jia Lian if they get news.
texts.贾琏嘱咐丫鬟板儿留意荣国府中来往人员与风闻，并及时向贾琏回报。: Jia Lian told the maid Ban'er to pay attention to comings and goings and rumors in Rongguo Mansion and to report back to Jia Lian promptly.
texts.贾琏在荣国府吩咐板儿备好被褥、日用与热水，以便照应刘姥姥。: At Rongguo Mansion, Jia Lian instructed Ban'er to prepare bedding, daily necessities, and hot water to attend to Granny Liu.
texts.贾琏在荣国府吩咐板儿，如果有人在厨房、怡红院或贾母处谈论京中与宁荣街的事，也要记: At Rongguo Mansion, Jia Lian instructed Ban'er that if anyone in the kitchen, Yihong Yuan, or Grandmother's place discussed affairs of the capital and Ningrong Street, she should record the speakers' names, their purpose, and the content of the conversation.
texts.贾琏在荣国府吩咐板儿，见到贾芸回府时要替刘姥姥多关照。: At Rongguo Mansion, Jia Lian told Ban'er to take extra care of Granny Liu when she saw Jia Yun return to the mansion.
texts.贾琏在荣国府命人把里屋收拾妥当。: At Rongguo Mansion, Jia Lian ordered servants to tidy up the inner room.
texts.贾琏在荣国府对板儿说：姥姥先在里屋歇息。: At Rongguo Mansion, Jia Lian told Ban'er that Granny Liu should rest first in the inner room.
texts.贾琏在荣国府对板儿说：王夫人和凤姐暂不在府中。: At Rongguo Mansion, Jia Lian told Ban'er that Lady Wang and Wang Xifeng were temporarily not in the mansion.
texts.贾琏在荣国府对板儿说：饭食约半刻功夫就会备好。: At Rongguo Mansion, Jia Lian told Ban'er that the meal would be ready in about half a ke.
texts.贾琏在荣国府已吩咐仆人收拾荣国府的里屋，并安排人搀扶来访的姥姥到里屋安置。: At Rongguo Mansion, Jia Lian had instructed servants to tidy the mansion's inner room and arranged for people to escort the visiting Granny Liu to the inner room.
texts.贾琏在荣国府得知:王夫人和凤姐暂时不在府中。: At Rongguo Mansion, Jia Lian learned that Lady Wang and Wang Xifeng were temporarily not in the mansion.
texts.贾琏对贾芸表示贾琏不知道小红的下落。: Jia Lian told Jia Yun that Jia Lian did not know Xiao Hong's whereabouts.
texts.贾琏已吩咐人到各处探问小红的下落。: Jia Lian had ordered people to go everywhere to inquire about Xiao Hong's whereabouts.
texts.贾琏搀扶并安置刘姥姥在荣国府的里屋。: Jia Lian supported and settled Granny Liu in the inner room of Rongguo Mansion.
texts.贾芸在蘅芜苑向众女子打听小红的下落。: Jia Yun asked the women in Hengwu Garden about Xiao Hong's whereabouts.
texts.贾芸已到稻香村报到，并承接了在稻香村的种树差事。: Jia Yun had reported to Daoxiang Village and taken on the tree-planting assignment there.
texts.贾芸已向贾莲发消息，打听小红的下落。: Jia Yun had sent a message to Jia Lian asking about Xiao Hong's whereabouts.
texts.贾芸确认:小红已往蘅芜院。: Jia Yun confirmed that Xiao Hong had gone to Hengwu Garden.
texts.贾蓉告诉茗烟，贾宝玉现在在大观楼正厅一带，正陪在众人旁。: Jia Rong told Mingyan that Jia Baoyu was now in the main hall area of the Grand View Pavilion, sitting with the others.
texts.贾蓉嘱咐茗烟保持潇湘馆室内安静并准备薄粥以供林黛玉食用。: Jia Rong instructed Mingyan to keep Xiaoxiang Pavilion quiet and to prepare thin porridge for Lin Daiyu to eat.
texts.贾蓉嘱咐茗烟继续在潇湘馆床前照料林黛玉。: Jia Rong instructed Mingyan to continue caring for Lin Daiyu at her bedside in Xiaoxiang Pavilion.
texts.贾蓉嘱咐茗烟若林黛玉有异样，立即呼唤其他家人或丫鬟并速请太医来诊治。: Jia Rong instructed Mingyan that if Lin Daiyu showed any abnormality she should immediately call other family members or maids and swiftly summon the imperial physician to examine her.
texts.贾蓉指示紫鹃立即去请贾宝玉。: Jia Rong ordered Zijuan to go immediately to fetch Jia Baoyu.
texts.贾蓉询问茗烟，是否现在上去把贾宝玉请来，还是请茗烟先在此等回话。: Jia Rong asked Mingyan whether to go now to fetch Jia Baoyu or have Mingyan stay here and await a reply.
texts.贾迎春作的这首诗前两句写道：“海棠幽处半含春，疏影融香绕槛云。”: The first two lines of the poem Jia Yingchun composed read: 'In the begonia's seclusion half embraces spring; sparse shadows blend fragrance around the balustrade like clouds.'
texts.贾迎春作的这首诗后两句写道：“偷得片时闲照眼，寂寞无心也自闻。”: The last two lines read: 'Stealing a moment's leisure to brighten the eyes; in solitude, without intent, it is still perceived.'
texts.贾迎春向林黛玉回礼，称已拜读林黛玉的诗文。: Jia Yingchun returned Lin Daiyu's greeting, saying she had read Lin Daiyu's poetry.
texts.贾迎春在海棠诗社小聚现场朗诵一阕名为《海棠》的诗。: At the Haitang Poetry Club gathering, Jia Yingchun recited a poem titled 'Begonia.'
texts.贾迎春在蘅芜苑参加由贾探春发起的海棠诗社小聚。: Jia Yingchun attended the Haitang Poetry Club gathering in Hengwu Garden organized by Jia Tanchun.
texts.贾迎春在蘅芜苑的小聚期间听闻贾芸在寻人。: During the gathering in Hengwu Garden, Jia Yingchun heard that Jia Yun was searching for someone.
texts.贾迎春当场向在场的人询问小红的下落。: Jia Yingchun asked those present on the spot about Xiaohong's whereabouts.
texts.轻声呼唤林黛玉，替小姐递上药茶，留在床边照料，随时安慰小姐并观察她的状况: Softly call Lin Daiyu, hand the young mistress medicinal tea, remain at the bedside to tend her, comfort the young mistress as needed, and observe her condition.
texts.迎春随李纨在蘅芜苑的曲栏就座。: Jia Yingchun sat with Li Wan at the curved railing in Hengwu Garden.
